content: Unlike LSTM-based seq2seq models, where $\alpha $ can be more easily tuned by grid search, in a Transformer, there are many attention heads in multiple layers. Crucial to the power of such models, the different heads capture different linguistic phenomena, some of them isolating important words, others spreading out attention across phrases BIBREF0. This motivates using different, adaptive $\alpha $ values for each attention head, such that some heads may learn to be sparser, and others may become closer to softmax. We propose doing so by treating the $\alpha $ values as neural network parameters, optimized via stochastic gradients along with the other weights.
